sentences.text: The official table of TAI-UTC runs from 10 seconds in 1972 to 37 seconds in 2017, climbing by exactly one second at every entry.

assertions.text: The IERS table of TAI-UTC lists values from 10 s on 1 January 1972 to 37 s on 1 January 2017, each exactly one second larger than the one before.

validation.text: The IERS table of TAI-UTC lists values from 10 s on 1 January 1972 to 37 s on 1 January 2017, each exactly one second larger than the one before.
